title: setup enables project plugins that doctor says are missing
what: After relay setup, relay doctor reports no plugin as not installed: setup installs the plugins it enables at project scope, or puts the exact command in its to-do list.
why: 25 Oct, the throwaway project (scratchpad reports/demo-and-release.md, part 1): setup enabled core, delegate, front and observe in .claude/settings.json; relay doctor then gave 4 FIX "not installed at project scope", and setup's to-do list did not name the install. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: relay setup <tmp project> then relay doctor <tmp project>: FIX lines for core, delegate, front, observe; the setup output has no install command for them.
pass_cases: After setup, doctor has no "not installed" FIX, or setup's to-do names `claude plugin install <name>@relay --scope project` for each.

fact: Migration 27 Oct: the link in `why` line 1 points to a session file (`reports/demo-and-release.md`, part 1, 25 Oct), which is deleted when the machine restarts; the facts it held that this item rests on are the notes below.

Measured 25 Oct in the same throwaway project: `relay doctor shop` gave 31 ok and 6 to fix. The fixes: mypy not installed (the machine), the ledger empty (no sessions), and 4 plugins (core, delegate, front, observe) not installed at project scope: setup only switched them on in settings and neither ran `claude plugin install ... --scope project` nor listed it as a to-do.

Reproduced 30 Oct by the trial on a copy of relay cleaned of relay (sandbox HOME, claude stubbed to fail): `relay setup` printed no 'enabled but not installed' to-do, and `relay doctor <dir>` right after reported 4 FIX '<plugin>@amidman installed (claude plugin install ... --scope project)'.
